Mick's voice comes through, asking why John never answers his phone. Before John can react, a man in a helmet taps on his side window. John turns and sees that Mike has pulled up on a motorcycle, unnoticed. His hand moves toward the split between the seats but stops. The second rider pulls up beside the passenger window. Mike tells John he was supposed to leave. John says he needs the documents. Mike points out the man who just left had a red light in his back window—indicating he was a cop. John doesn't know which man Mike means. Mike hands over the passports with their new names. John gives him an envelope of money. Mike counts it, then warns John that wanting something too much will cause him to ruin it. Mike drives off, followed by the second rider.
related_events: John accesses his voicemail
Mike arrives on a motorcycle and taps on John's window

name: John and Mike's Exchange in the Parking Lot
description: The guy leaves the restaurant and walks to his car. John watches him, checking his watch—it's 2:45. The man sees John and stares before driving away, leaving the lot empty. John presses the VOICEMAIL button on his phone. MICK (V.O.) asks why he never answers his phone. Suddenly, a man in a helmet taps on John's side window. Mike has pulled up without John noticing. John's hand moves toward the split between the seats but stops. A second rider pulls up to the passenger side. Mike tells John he was supposed to leave. John says he needs them. Mike asks if John noticed the man was a cop. John asks which one. Mike points out the red light in the back window of the departing car. Mike hands John a set of documents. He tells John to give him the money. John passes over an envelope. Mike opens it and checks the contents. He tells John he wants this too much and is going to mess it up. Mike drives off quickly. The second rider looks at John, then follows Mike. John examines the passports, now bearing new names.
related_events: Mike confronts John about failing to leave as instructed
Mike warns John about the man being a police officer
John expresses his need to stay

Mike checks the money in the envelope

name: Mike Departs After Warning John
description: After handing over the passports and receiving the envelope of money, Mike tells John he wants the deal too much and is going to ruin it. He then gets back on his motorcycle and speeds away. The second rider, who had been waiting nearby, looks at John for a moment before turning and following Mike down the road.
related_events: Mike warns John about wanting the deal too much
Mike speeds off from the location
Second rider gives John a meaningful look before leaving
Second rider follows Mike

name: John Examines the New Passports
description: After the motorcyclists leave, John sits in the car and looks over the passports. He studies the new names and the falsified information inside, running his fingers over the pages.
related_events: John examines the passports with new names

name: Second Rider Arrives at Passenger Window
description: Mike confronts John by the car, speaking through the driver's side window. As they talk, the second rider pulls up on his motorcycle and stops beside the passenger side window, positioning himself there. He remains silent, watching.
related_events: Second rider approaches the passenger side window

name: John Realizes the Man Was a Cop
description: The man leaves the restaurant and walks to his car. John watches him, checking his watch—it reads 2:45. The man drives away, leaving the parking lot empty. John presses the VOICEMAIL button on his phone. Mick’s voice comes through: “Are you ever going to answer your goddamn phone?” Suddenly, a man in a helmet taps on John’s side window. Mike has pulled up beside him, unnoticed. John’s hand moves toward the split between the seats but stops. A second rider pulls up to the passenger side. Mike says, “You were supposed to leave.” John replies, “I need them.” Mike asks if John noticed the man was a cop. John asks which one. Mike points out the red light in the back window of the departing car. John sits quietly, the realization settling in. Mike hands over the documents. He tells John to give him the money. John passes him an envelope. Mike counts the cash and says, “You want this too much. You’re going to fuck it up.” Mike drives off, followed by the second rider, who gives John a final look. John examines the passports, now bearing new names.
related_events: John realizes his mistake and feels foolish

name: Luke Asks for Cookies and Gives Them to Carrie
description: Luke approaches John and asks for his cookies. John hands him two packaged cookies. Luke runs off and gives the cookies to Carrie, who is sitting nearby with her mother, Nicole.
related_events: Luke requests his cookies from John
John gives Luke two packaged cookies
Luke delivers cookies to Carrie

name: Nicole Apologizes and Reconnects with John
description: Nicole calls out to her daughter, Carrie, and apologizes to John for the girl's behavior. She introduces herself, and John responds by saying he remembers her. When she questions that, he admits with a smile that he actually only remembers her daughter. She laughs lightly and says Carrie is hard to forget.
related_events: Nicole apologizes to John for Carrie's behavior
John acknowledges remembering Nicole

name: Nicole Gives John a Birthday Invitation
description: Nicole reaches into her bag and pulls out an envelope, handing it to John. He opens it and sees a birthday invitation with jungle animals on the cover. 'He has his father's memory,' John says. Nicole tells him it's for Carrie's birthday party and invites him to come, adding that she'd like to meet his wife. John looks at the invitation and says his wife can't make it, that it's complicated.
related_events: Nicole reveals the envelope was meant for John
John receives a birthday invitation from Nicole
Nicole invites John to Carrie's birthday party

name: John Declines the Birthday Invitation
description: John stands on the sidewalk with Nicole after their walk from the park. She invites him to join her and Carrie for lunch at the cafe on the corner. He hesitates, then declines, saying they should be getting home. Nicole acknowledges the refusal with a quiet 'Oh, okay,' feigning mild disappointment. John holds up the birthday invitation she gave him, saying they’ll try to make it to Carrie’s party. Nicole responds that would be great. He turns, walks back to where Luke is playing, scoops him up, and heads away without looking back. Nicole watches them go, her expression unreadable.
related_events: John declines invitation due to personal complications

name: Nicole Invites John to Lunch
description: Nicole suggests that John join her, Carrie, and Luke for lunch at the cafe on the corner. John hesitates, saying they’re pretty busy, and Nicole responds with a teasing tone, calling him out for being busy. He smiles, caught. She insists, saying they owe him for the cookies. John replies that he made those cookies, and Nicole jokes that he must have learned how to pre-package them. He adds that it requires a considerable amount of machinery. They begin walking toward the street, the children trailing behind. After a moment of silence, Nicole asks if he trades off time with Luke, and John explains that he has full-time custody. She remarks that’s probably why she sees him so often. John says Luke’s mother would want to be there but can’t. When Nicole assumes it’s complicated, he tells her the truth—Luke’s mother is in prison. Nicole reacts with quiet surprise. John says he doesn’t tell many people, and adds that she’s innocent. Nicole murmurs agreement, unsure what to say. John says they should be going. Nicole feigns disappointment and says okay. He thanks her for the birthday invitation and says they’ll try to make it. She says that would be great. John walks back, picks up Luke, and heads off, while Nicole watches, visibly taken aback.
related_events: Nicole invites John to join them for lunch
John hesitates but accepts lunch invitation

name: John Tells Nicole About Lara's Imprisonment
description: John and Nicole walk together toward the street, the children trailing behind. The conversation turns to Luke’s time with John, and when Nicole asks if they trade off parenting, John replies that he and Luke are together full time. Nicole comments that it explains why she sees them so often. John adds that Lara, Luke’s other parent, would want to be there too—she misses being part of it all. After a pause, he says, 'She's in prison.' Nicole reacts with quiet shock. John looks at her and says, 'I don't tell most people.' Nicole murmurs, 'I understand.' John insists, 'She's innocent. She didn't kill the woman.' Nicole replies, '...Good. I mean, I'm sure she didn't,' then falls silent, unsure what to say. John says they should be going. Nicole feigns disappointment and says okay. He thanks her for the birthday invitation. She says it would be great if they could come. John waves the envelope and heads back to pick up Luke. Nicole watches them leave, her expression caught between surprise and confusion.
related_events: John reveals that Lara is in prison
Nicole reacts to learning about Lara's imprisonment

name: John and Luke Leave After the Conversation
description: John thanked Nicole for the birthday invitation, holding it up as he spoke. He turned, scooped Luke into his arms, and began walking away. Nicole watched them go, standing with Carrie beside the bench. The two adults did not say goodbye, and the children trailed behind before being called to leave.
related_events: John and Luke prepare to leave after conversation with Nicole
